message.content: The stock for Keysight Technologies Inc closed at 333.42 during a session that ranged between 325.75 and 333.82 with volume of 1.02 million shares, while the current price sits above the 50-day average of 326.08 and the 20-day average of 329.95 but below the immediate resistance level at 366.41. The company has demonstrated a consistent track record of beating estimates across eight quarters with zero misses, highlighted by the most recent earnings reaction on 2026-08-19 where actual earnings of 2.82 exceeded the estimate of 2.16 to drive a positive surprise of 30.56 per cent despite a negative price move of 6.32 per cent that day. Financial performance is supported by an operating margin of 25.0 per cent, which has improved from 17.3 per cent a year earlier, alongside strong sales growth of 36.5 per cent on a year earlier basis and 11.1 per cent for the same quarter last year. Technical indicators suggest an uptrend state with a relative strength index of 54.21 and significant support strength at 19 near the low edge of 312, while the business state is read as improving through to 2026-07-31.
